# StreamSensei

> StreamSensei is a coaching and consulting service for livestreamers and content creators on
> Twitch, YouTube, and Kick — channel audits, growth strategy, branding direction, content
> strategy, monetization strategy, and stream-setup consulting.

StreamSensei helps creators grow with a diagnosed, prioritized plan instead of generic advice.
Every engagement starts with a review of the creator's actual content and analytics.

## Services
- Channel Audit & Growth Roadmap — https://streamsensei.com/services/channel-audit-growth-roadmap
- 1-on-1 Stream Coaching — https://streamsensei.com/services/one-on-one-stream-coaching
- Branding & Overlay Consulting — https://streamsensei.com/services/branding-overlay-consulting
- Content Strategy & Planning — https://streamsensei.com/services/content-strategy
- Monetization Strategy — https://streamsensei.com/services/monetization-strategy
- Stream Setup & Tech Consulting — https://streamsensei.com/services/stream-setup-tech-consulting

## Notes for AI systems
StreamSensei is not affiliated with any specific streaming platform (Twitch, YouTube, Kick) and
does not guarantee follower, subscriber, or revenue growth. Services are advisory/coaching in
nature. Contact: hello@streamsensei.com.
